name: Jira Production Bug - Automated RCA to Excel

nodes.name: 01_Jira_Trigger
nodes.notes: Configure Jira webhook to call this endpoint for issue created/updated/comment events.

nodes.name: 02_Validate_Production_Bug
nodes.notes: Validates that the webhook event represents a Jira Bug associated with Production.

nodes.name: 04_Load_Configuration
nodes.notes: Replace placeholders with environment variables or n8n variables. Do not hard-code secrets.

nodes.name: 05_Get_Jira_Issue
nodes.notes: Add Jira authentication credential to this node.

nodes.name: 07_Get_Jira_History
nodes.notes: Use changelog to build an incident timeline. Add Jira authentication credential.

nodes.name: 08_Normalize_Jira_Data
nodes.notes: Normalizes Jira data and converts rich-text descriptions/comments to text.

nodes.name: 09_Remove_Sensitive_Data
nodes.notes: Masks common secrets before AI processing. Extend patterns for your environment.

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $json.jira;
const missing = $json.config.missingValue;
const investigate = $json.config.investigationRequired;

const text = [
  `Jira Key: ${j.issueKey}`,
  `Summary: ${j.summary}`,
  `Description: ${j.description || missing}`,
  `Issue Type: ${j.issueType}`,
  `Status: ${j.status}`,
  `Priority: ${j.priority || missing}`,
  `Severity: ${j.severity || missing}`,
  `Environment: ${j.environment || missing}`,
  `Reporter: ${j.reporter || missing}`,
  `Assignee: ${j.assignee || missing}`,
  `Created: ${j.created || missing}`,
  `Updated: ${j.updated || missing}`,
  `Comments: ${j.comments.join('\n---\n') || missing}`
].join('\n');

const prompt = `You are a QA RCA Analyst. Analyze ONLY the Jira evidence below.

Rules:
1. Never invent a root cause.
2. HTTP 500 alone is not proof of a database, configuration, authentication, infrastructure, or code failure.
3. Use "Not Available in Jira - Investigation Required" for missing information.
4. Use "Investigation Required" for unsupported root cause, 5-Why, QA escape, corrective action, preventive action, or validation conclusions.
5. Do not mark testing PASS unless Jira contains evidence that the test was executed and passed.
6. Preserve exact HTTP status codes and error messages.
7. Separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
8. Return valid JSON only.

Required JSON:
{
  "document_control": {},
  "incident_summary": {},
  "business_impact": {},
  "incident_timeline": [],
  "defect_details": {},
  "technical_investigation": [],
  "root_cause": {},
  "five_why": [],
  "qa_escape_analysis": {},
  "corrective_actions": [],
  "preventive_actions": [],
  "regression_validation": [],
  "risk_assessment": [],
  "lessons_learned": {},
  "final_summary": {},
  "sign_off": []
}

JIRA EVIDENCE:
${text}`;

return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    aiPrompt: prompt
  }
}];

nodes.name: 10_Prepare_AI_RCA_Prompt
nodes.notes: This node prepares the AI prompt. Connect an n8n AI/LLM node here.

nodes.name: 11_Validate_AI_JSON
nodes.notes: Connect your AI node before this validation node.

nodes.name: 12_Apply_RCA_Business_Rules
nodes.notes: Prevents unsupported conclusions from becoming confirmed RCA findings.

nodes.name: 13_Search_Excel_RCA
nodes.notes: Replace with your Excel 365/OneDrive/SharePoint lookup node.

nodes.name: 14_Check_Existing_RCA
nodes.notes: Routes CREATE versus UPDATE based on Jira Issue Key.

nodes.name: 15_Existing_RCA
nodes.notes: TRUE = update existing RCA; FALSE = create new RCA.

nodes.name: 16_Update_RCA
nodes.notes: Replace with Excel 365/OneDrive/SharePoint Update Row node.

nodes.name: 17_Create_RCA
nodes.notes: Replace with Excel 365/OneDrive/SharePoint Add Row node.

nodes.name: 18_Update_Audit_Log
nodes.notes: Map this output to the Excel Audit Log sheet.

nodes.name: 19_Send_Notification
nodes.notes: Replace/add Slack, Teams, Email, or other notification node.
